items.exampleEn: We had checked the weather beforehand, so the storm did not surprise us.
items.exampleZh: 我們事先查過天氣，所以這場暴風雨並沒有讓我們措手不及。

items.exampleEn: The village sits high in the mountains, hence its cool summers.
items.exampleZh: 這個村莊位在高山上，因此夏天很涼爽。

items.exampleEn: The old temple stands quietly amid tall office buildings.
items.exampleZh: 那座老廟靜靜地矗立在高聳的辦公大樓之間。

items.exampleEn: She sold her car and thereby saved a lot on parking fees.
items.exampleZh: 她把車賣了，因而省下很多停車費。

items.exampleEn: I do not ordinarily eat breakfast, but today I was very hungry.
items.exampleZh: 我平常不吃早餐，但今天我非常餓。

items.exampleEn: The plan went ahead, his objections notwithstanding.
items.exampleZh: 儘管他反對，計畫仍照常進行。

items.exampleEn: I learned to cook principally by watching my grandmother.
items.exampleZh: 我學做菜主要是靠看我奶奶煮。

items.exampleEn: Never use your phone whilst driving.
items.exampleZh: 開車的時候，絕對不要用手機。

items.exampleEn: People are apt to spend more when they go shopping hungry.
items.exampleZh: 人們餓著肚子去購物時，往往會花比較多錢。

items.exampleEn: The new rules pertain to drivers of large trucks only.
items.exampleZh: 新規定只適用於大型卡車的駕駛。

items.sentenceEn: Please read the instructions beforehand so the meeting runs smoothly.
items.sentenceZh: 請事先讀過說明，讓會議順利進行。

items.audioEn: Amid all the noise at the station, Tom could not hear the announcement about his train.
items.audioZh: 車站裡一片吵雜，Tom 聽不到關於他那班火車的廣播。
items.questionZh: Tom 為什麼聽不到廣播？

items.sentenceEn: The trip ordinarily takes forty minutes by train.
items.sentenceZh: 這段路搭火車通常要四十分鐘。

items.sentenceEn: Questions that pertain to your salary should go to the personnel office.
items.sentenceZh: 與薪資有關的問題，請洽人事室。

items.stemEn: The company moved its office closer to the station, ____ cutting travel time for most staff.
items.stemZh: 公司把辦公室搬到離車站比較近的地方，藉此縮短了大多數員工的通勤時間。

items.stemEn: ____ the heavy rain, thousands of fans waited patiently outside the stadium.
items.stemZh: 儘管下著大雨，仍有數千名球迷在體育場外耐心等候。

items.passageEn: Mia runs a small bakery in a busy part of town. Her customers are principally office workers who stop by on their way to work. Last month, amid the morning rush, one of her ovens suddenly stopped working. Mia stayed calm. Whilst her assistant served the waiting customers, she called a repair company. The man from the repair company explained that old ovens are apt to break down when they are used all day without a break. He fixed it within an hour. Since then, Mia has had her ovens checked every three months. Hence, she has had no further problems. She also tells customers beforehand whenever she plans to close the shop for repairs.
items.passageZh: Mia 在城裡熱鬧的地段經營一家小麵包店。她的客人主要是上班途中順路進來的上班族。上個月，正值早上的尖峰時段，她的一台烤箱突然停止運轉。Mia 保持冷靜。她的助手招呼等候的客人時，她打電話給修理公司。修理公司派來的人解釋說，舊烤箱整天不停使用的話，很容易故障。他在一小時內就修好了。從那之後，Mia 每三個月請人檢查一次烤箱，因此再也沒出過問題。每當她打算關店維修時，也會事先告知客人。

questions.questionZh: Mia 的客人主要是哪些人？
烤箱壞掉時，Mia 的助手在做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這場會議主要是為新進員工舉辦的。
referenceEn: This meeting is principally for new staff.
The meeting is being held principally for new employees.
rubricZh: principally 表示「主要地」，位置有彈性（例如 principally for new staff 等）
「新進員工」可寫，例如 new staff、new employees、new workers 等
動詞可寫，例如 is、is held、is being held 等

items.promptZh: 這台舊印表機在潮濕的天氣裡容易故障。
referenceEn: This old printer is apt to break down in wet weather.
The old printer is apt to stop working when the weather is damp.
rubricZh: 「容易⋯」用 be apt to＋原形動詞（例如 is apt to break down 等）
「故障」可寫，例如 break down、stop working 等
「潮濕的天氣」可寫，例如 wet weather、damp weather、when it is wet 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似多加資訊：fans 在 stadium 外等候未必是演唱會，譯「歌迷」限定了情境；可譯「球迷／粉絲」或中性的「數千人」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 中譯「歌迷」改為中性的「數千人」：「儘管下著大雨，仍有數千人在體育場外耐心等候。」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似干擾項一眼可排除：aloud、abroad 為低級字且語意與「縮短通勤時間」完全無關，只剩 seldom 稍有干擾力。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: aloud、abroad 換成本課副詞 beforehand、ordinarily（代入「縮短通勤時間」語意不通），保留 seldom；四選項仍同為副詞

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q16 干擾項 Enthusiastically 跨課重複（u08-l04 亦用），且三個干擾項皆放不進介系詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項改為 Instead of／Regarding／Whilst：Instead of、Regarding 為介系詞、放得進空格但語意不通（混合詞性題至少兩個放得進空格），Whilst 不能接名詞

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：whilst 例句「Some people love the summer heat, whilst others prefer cold winters.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「當⋯時」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「Never use your phone whilst driving.」示範第一義；釋義為「當⋯時；而、然而（英式）」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：用 be apt to＋原形動詞表示「容易⋯、往往會⋯」（例如 am apt to forget 等）
